scale.name: demo
scale.warning: DEMO SCALE: 30 x 20 mm test article. This is what we can print and emboss today, NOT the device. The design target is the ANSI/SLAS microplate footprint 127.76 x 85.48 mm, 18x this area. Do not read any dimension on these files as the real device.

origin: the chip-spec origin: (0, 0) at the lower-left corner of the footprint, z = 0 at the underside of the chip. Every file in this bundle shares it.

geometry_method.grid: rectilinear, lines on the feature edges
geometry_method.note: axis-aligned features are exact; round port pads and diagonal runs are stepped at the sampling pitch, a quarter of the in-plane floor

resin_print.makes: the tool, and the chip directly for a one-off
resin_print.tooling_at_the_agreed_ceiling: Formlabs Form 4L, 353 x 196 mm build. Fits with 63 x 6 mm margin.

hot_emboss.makes: the production chip, pressed from the resin tool into COC/COP sheet
hot_emboss.mould: mirrored in x, so the EMBOSSED chip matches the spec seen from the port side
hot_emboss.tooling_at_the_agreed_ceiling: 296 mm square platen (Collin P300S class). Fits with 6 x 106 mm margin.
hot_emboss.not_usable: 300 mm ROUND wafer tools: a 290 x 190 rectangle has a 346.7 mm diagonal, so it does not fit a 300 mm round platen.

fabrication_routes.seal: a separate lid or film with drilled ports: the channels in this body are OPEN by design (contracts/blocks.json fabrication_floors.note)

cam_2d.makes: the cut outline, for any 2D route

checks.detail: 30 x 20 mm against the demo envelope 30 x 20 mm
one fluidic layer at one depth: 300 um
deepest feature 300 um against the 300 um ceiling
narrowest cut feature is 'ch_conn_1' at 200 um, floor 200 um
thinnest solid wall 400 um (between 'outlet_1_pad' and the edge of the footprint), floor 400 um
smallest bore 'inlet_1' at 0.8 mm, floor 0.8 mm
closest pair inlet_1-reagent_in at 14.37 mm, floor 5 mm
4 fluid ports against the demo envelope (30 x 20 mm) limit of 6
no two routed channels cross in plan view
every port hole opens onto enough cut channel, chamber or port pad
every port hole is reached by the channel or chamber the design routes to it
every feature is inside the footprint
all 19044 cells match: the mould is raised exactly where the body is cut (after un-mirroring in x)
4 of 4 channels have an explicit `path`, and every run of it was built; the rest use chip_from_spec's documented automatic route. No channel was drawn as a straight line between its endpoints.

dxf.note: $INSUNITS = 4 (mm) and $MEASUREMENT = 1 are in the HEADER, so no importer can scale this 25.4x. Every entity is a closed LWPOLYLINE; cut on the CUT layer, which is the traced boundary of the cut region and so has no line running through the inside of a pocket.
